test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

The boy said to the teacher, "Sir, I am weak in Maths and seek your advice."

options.text: The boy told the teacher that he was weak in Maths and seek his advice.
The boy told the teacher that he was weak in Maths and sought his advice.
The boy told the teacher that he is weak in Maths and see his advice.
The boy told that he was weak in Maths and sought his advice.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The boy told the teacher that he was weak in Maths and sought his advice."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the Simple Present Tense. 
 
• Indirect speech requires a change in tense, pronouns, and adverbs.
 
• The reporting verb said/said to is changed in asked, demanded, ordered, exclaimed and enquired as per the nature of the sentence.
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be used.
 
• The first person in the reported speech changes according to the subject of the reporting speech.
 
• In Reported Speech, the change of the second person depends on the object of reporting speech.
 
• The third person remains unchanged.
 
• Simple Present Tense 'is' converted into Simple Past Tense 'was'.
 
• Structure__: (Subject+ V1 + object) (Direct Speech)

 (Subject+ V2 + object) (Indirect Speech)
 
 
• Example: *Navin said, “He is young.”*
 
 

* Navin said that he was young. *

 
• 
 
**"Said to"** becomes **"told"** in indirect speech.

 
 
• 
 
**"I am"** becomes **"he was"** in indirect speech.

 
 
• **"Seek your advice"** becomes "sought his advice" in indirect speech.
 
• So, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
